build_dataloader_segmentation: build a dataloader for image segmentation datasets with transforms and distributed training support
create_imagefolder_dataset: create an image folder dataset that loads RGB images with optional transforms and mask transforms
run_get_image_paths: run a function that scans a directory for image files and caches the sorted paths as JSON
run_custom_collate: run a custom collate function that batches images and pads variable-length mask tensors
test_imagefolder_getitem: test the ImageFolder dataset __getitem__ method to verify image and mask tensor outputs
